flows.title: Create a dashboard
steps: Click +New Dashboard on the Dashboard List page, or New Dashboard from the navigation menu.
Enter a dashboard name and choose a layout option.

flows.title: Create a metric monitor
steps: Navigate to Monitors > New Monitor and select Metric. Threshold Alert is already selected as the detection method.
Define the metric the monitor watches.
Set the alert conditions, with an Alert threshold and optionally a Warning threshold.
Give the notification a title, which must be unique for each monitor, and a message telling your team how to resolve the issue.
Choose who is notified, by email, Slack, PagerDuty and more.

flows.title: Search logs
steps: Choose the time window with the time range selector at the top right.
Type a search query, combining key:value pairs such as status:error with full-text search. Autocomplete suggests keys, values, recent searches and saved views.
To describe what to find in plain English instead, click Ask in the search field, where Natural Language Queries are available.
